definitions.gloss: pivotal; vital; of central importance; crucial
definitions.explanation: Describes something that is of key importance, occupying a central or essential position. A formal, written word.

examples.japanese: {枢要|すうよう}な⟦{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たす→役割を果たす：19503_yakuwariwohatasu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{交通|こうつう}→交通：01584_koutsuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{枢要|すうよう}な⟦{位置|いち}→位置：11554_ichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This area occupies a vital position for transportation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{安全保障|あんぜんほしょう}→安全保障：05788_anzenhoshou⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧{枢要|すうよう}な⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{厳重|げんじゅう}→厳重：11887_genjuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Information that is vital to national security is strictly managed.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, literary word used primarily in written contexts such as news articles, academic texts, and official documents. Derives from {枢|すう} (pivot/axis), suggesting something at the very center or hinge point.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {枢要|すうよう}な⟦{地位|ちい}→地位：03427_chii⟧ (a pivotal position)
- {枢要|すうよう}な⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧ (a vital role)
- {枢要|すうよう}な⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧ (a key figure)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧: important — the standard, everyday word
- {肝要|かんよう}: essential, crucial — also formal, emphasizes indispensability
